import re

def parse_duration(text: str) -> float:
    # Must start with P
    if not text or text[0] != 'P':
        raise ValueError("Duration must start with 'P'")
    
    remaining = text[1:]
    
    if not remaining:
        raise ValueError("Duration must have at least one component")
    
    # Check if this is a week-only format (P<n>W)
    if 'W' in remaining:
        # Should be only weeks, no other components
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)W', remaining)
        if not match:
            raise ValueError("Invalid week format")
        weeks = match.group(1).replace(',', '.')
        return float(weeks) * 7 * 86400
    
    total = 0.0
    
    # Parse date part (before T)
    time_part_str = ""
    if 'T' in remaining:
        date_part, time_part_str = remaining.split('T', 1)
        if not time_part_str:
            raise ValueError("T must be followed by at least one time component")
    else:
        date_part = remaining
    
    # Parse date part: P<n>D or empty
    if date_part:
        if 'Y' in date_part:
            raise ValueError("Years are not supported")
        if 'M' in date_part:
            raise ValueError("Months are not supported")
        
        # Match days: <n>D (with optional fraction)
        match = re.match(r'(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)D', date_part)
        if match:
            days = match.group(1).replace(',', '.')
            total += float(days) * 86400
            date_part = date_part[len(match.group(0)):]
        
        if date_part:
            raise ValueError("Invalid date component")
    
    # Parse time part: <n>H<n>M<n>S
    if time_part_str:
        # H component
        match = re.match(r'(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)H', time_part_str)
        if match:
            hours = match.group(1).replace(',', '.')
            total += float(hours) * 3600
            time_part_str = time_part_str[len(match.group(0)):]
        
        # M component (minutes)
        match = re.match(r'(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)M', time_part_str)
        if match:
            minutes = match.group(1).replace(',', '.')
            total += float(minutes) * 60
            time_part_str = time_part_str[len(match.group(0)):]
        
        # S component (seconds) - can have fraction
        match = re.match(r'(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)S', time_part_str)
        if match:
            seconds = match.group(1).replace(',', '.')
            total += float(seconds)
            time_part_str = time_part_str[len(match.group(0)):]
        
        if time_part_str:
            raise ValueError("Invalid time component")
    
    if total == 0:
        raise ValueError("Duration must have at least one component")
    
    return total
